sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "iban" TEXT NULL, "opening_balance_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "opening_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "color_value" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "color_value" INTEGER NOT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'category', "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "import_profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "delimiter" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "encoding" TEXT NOT NULL, "header_row" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "date_format" TEXT NOT NULL, "decimal_separator" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "mapping" TEXT NOT NULL, "invert_sign" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("invert_sign" IN (0, 1)), "debit_indicators" TEXT NOT NULL, "json_root_path" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "import_batches" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "account_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "profile_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES import_profiles (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "imported_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "imported_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "duplicate_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "category_rules" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "match_all" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("match_all" IN (0, 1)), "conditions" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_enabled" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "account_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "booking_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "value_date" INTEGER NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "counterparty" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "purpose" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "counterparty_iban" TEXT NULL, "category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "category_source" TEXT NOT NULL, "rule_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES category_rules (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "trained_category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "import_batch_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES import_batches (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "dedup_hash" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "classifier_tokens" ("token" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "count" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("token", "category_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "classifier_categories" ("category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "document_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("category_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "planned_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "interval" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NULL, "category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "account_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_month" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_month" INTEGER NULL, "color_value" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budget_categories" ("budget_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES budgets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("budget_id", "category_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "savings_goals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "saved_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "target_month" INTEGER NOT NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "account_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "color_value" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_setting_entries" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX transactions_account_date ON transactions (account_id, booking_date)
CREATE INDEX transactions_dedup ON transactions (account_id, dedup_hash)
